title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. This is a fully remote, project-based position. You will be brought on as an independent contractor for an initial 3-month project, with the possibility of extending into a long-term role based on performance and ongoing need. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. We're building a report powered entirely by real, proprietary compliance data and auditing experience. In this role, you'll help uncover the real story behind how insurance compliance actually works across real estate and construction: where processes break down at scale, where the biggest risks and operational strain hide, how teams can gain more control over their workflows, and where AI can help versus where human expertise still matters most. Your work will help Jones tell a sharper, more credible story about compliance - grounded entirely in real data. Position Overview As a Data Analyst Consultant, you'll determine which insights can be credibly supported by Jones' data and help define clear and defensible metrics. In doing so, you'll translate broad business questions into measures that reflect how Jones actually manages insurance compliance, documenting how each is defined, what data it draws on, and what limitations apply. You'll work with internal teams to access, clean, and analyze the relevant data, partnering closely with our insurance specialists to fact-check findings and ensure the analysis reflects real-world compliance behavior. The goal isn't simply to produce charts, but to understand what Jones' data can credibly and concretely reveal about the state of the industry and its dynamics - turning that understanding into clean, well-documented outputs that our Marketing team can build into a compelling, data-backed report. What You’ll Do Deliver a prioritized list of report insights that are feasible using Jones' proprietary data, including rationale for prioritization. Work hands-on with complex, real-world operational data – including gaps, inconsistencies, and evolving definitions – applying sound judgement to clean and structure it for analysis, flagging any issues that could affect validity. Develop structured, repeatable methods for processing and analyzing data. Produce clean, analysis- and chart-ready data outputs (tables, aggregates, etc.). Document methodology, data provenance, cleaning rules, assumptions, limitations, and required caveats for all analyses. Collaborate closely with Jones' insurance specialists to validate that data interpretations match real-world compliance behavior and operational workflows. Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Operations, responding to ad hoc requests for specific data cuts and insights. Help shape decisions about what's ready to share publicly, balancing business impact with analytical rigor. Summarize the strongest findings in a concise, executive-ready brief highlighting business relevance and confidence levels. Who You Are 2+ years of data analysis experience, with strong SQL skills. Experience working with SaaS, product, customer, or operations data. Skilled at cleaning messy or incomplete datasets without losing analytical rigor. Strong judgment in metric design, able to turn ambiguous questions into clear analysis. Experience producing external-facing benchmarks or data-backed thought leadership Excellent written and spoken English;
can explain technical findings to non-technical teams. Strong documentation habits. Comfortable challenging assumptions when data doesn't support the desired narrative. Available 40 hrs/week during U.S. business hours. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We’re Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Senior Sustainability Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Sustainability Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is Energizer Holdings, Inc. Energizer Holdings responsibly creates products to make lives easier and more enjoyable. To do this, we lean into our culture as an organization – we win together, while serving each other, with a willingness to act boldly, all while doing right. Our colleagues hail from all backgrounds, nationalities and walks of life, but our shared mission and purpose make us one team. Because we’re a global organization, you will always have opportunities to learn, grow and develop in your career. We support flexible working arrangements wherever possible. Position Summary The Senior Sustainability Analyst plays a key role in advancing the company's sustainability strategy, reporting, compliance, and performance management programs. This position leads sustainability data collection, greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, reporting, assurance, and audit activities. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across global operations, the role ensures data integrity, transparency, and alignment with corporate sustainability goals and external reporting requirements. The role also provides project management support for sustainability initiatives, including coordinating meetings, tracking action items, developing presentations and communications, and supporting implementation of strategic priorities and programs. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing complex sustainability data and reporting processes across multiple global facilities. Responsibilities Specific Accountabilities Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Accounting & Emissions Management: Lead global Scope 1, Scope 2, and applicable Scope 3 GHG inventory development, data collection, emissions calculations, and reporting. Maintain GHG methodologies, documentation, and data quality in alignment with the GHG Protocol and regulatory requirements. Partner with internal and external stakeholders to validate emissions data, support reduction initiatives, and ensure audit readiness. Sustainability Reporting & Disclosure Management: Lead project management and execution of the annual Sustainability Report, including timelines, stakeholder engagement, and approvals. Coordinate content development, source documentation, communications, training materials, and website disclosures. Assurance, Audit & Internal Controls: Serve as the primary contact for sustainability audits and external assurance engagements. Coordinate audit requests, maintain supporting evidence, and ensure effective reporting controls and governance. Identify risks, implement corrective actions, and support successful completion of audits and assurance reviews. Program Support: Support implementation of evolving sustainability standards, frameworks, controls, and documentation processes. Coordinate project meetings, stakeholder engagement, action-item tracking, and program documentation. What we are looking for Required Skills and Experience Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Environmental Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Minimum of 3+ years of experience in greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, applying the Greenhouse Gas Protocol and related emissions reporting methodologies across multiple global facilities and operations. Experience with external GHG emissions audits, assurance engagements, and verification processes. Knowledge of sustainability reporting frameworks, regulations, and assurance requirements, including GRI, ISSB, CSRD, and related disclosure standards. Proficiency with sustainability data management systems (e.G., Metrio) and advanced Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint. Strong project management, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience supporting corporate sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and cross-functional initiatives across global operations. Professional certifications in sustainability, environmental management, or GHG accounting are a plus. Come join us! Energizer is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination based on age, color, disability, marital or parental status, veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. O que buscamos: Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT. Responsabilidades: Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura. Requisitos Obrigatórios Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro Desejável: Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. GraphQL. Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou .NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. title: Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED! The World's Most Driven Remote Operations Specialist About Chore Chore exists to kill admin so founders can\ "Chore No More\" and build their dreams. We are the end of admin. We are the future. We are the better world for everyone. We exist to make every startup in the world successful. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning. Check out more of what we do here: The Role We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists - the main conduit through which all of our clients' back-office operations run, including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance. As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship - you own the operations. In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on. These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless - and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first. Some Examples Of The Work We Do Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness - “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?” Work that gets genuinely strategic - e.G., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients. Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases. An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind. Our clients are early-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget - not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to. Contributing to our knowledge base. Internal, client-facing, and public-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice - and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice. Internal projects that make Chore stronger. SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements - scoped, executed and delivered by you. One note on scope: unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go-to-market, analytics or partnerships. What We're Looking For Required 3+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties. This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's. Strongly preferred HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience (We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background) And you're probably a fit if… You're a total geek for better processes - more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. Ticking items off your list while thinking\ "how could I do this more efficiently?\ " brings a smile to your face. There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter - you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries You're smart, detail-oriented, a natural context-switcher, with GREAT communication skills You have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by people - going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically You're open to giving and receiving feedback, up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method You start solving before you start asking. When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup - dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the\ "startup plumber\" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2+ years). This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth - but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months Nice to have, not required An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early-stage startup finance Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite Why This Role Is Special You will run real companies behind the scenes. Very few roles give you this much impact this early You get ownership from day one. From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies - not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility You get rare visibility. You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this You work with sharp, ambitious teammates who care deeply about doing things well You will grow faster than you imagined - start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs Compensation & Logistics Compensation. We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses of up to 30% based on performance. India - $12K USD/year Nigeria / Africa - $10.4K USD/year LATAM - $13K USD/year Note : we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics. Equity. All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure. Benefits (all eligible after you complete the 60-day probation period) Up to $250/month WFH stipend Up to $50/month wellness stipend Location. We're remote-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours. Schedule. US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit. Read Before Applying We believe in being upfront about the hard parts. US hours are required and can be demanding. This may not be suitable for everyone Remote work has real challenges. You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace High ambiguity. You must create structure, not wait for it Extreme context-switching. You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time Feedback fluency. You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways High ownership. Minimal hand-holding. You are expected to self-manage Client-facing pressure. Founders move fast and expect clarity 60-day fully paid probation period. We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates. If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit. ❤️ Our Values Delight All Stakeholders. Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself Meritocracy. We reward value created - not longevity Experiment & Adapt. Try things, learn fast, improve continuously Assume Good Intentions. Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY) Please read this section carefully - following the instructions is part of how we assess applications. Your application has two parts. Both are required. Step 1 - Record a short video Record one video, no longer than 3 minutes, answering these two questions: 1. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?2. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own - not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved. A few notes: Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred) We're not judging production quality - we want to hear how you think We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please. title: Information Technology Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Business Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior IT Business Analyst Role Overview The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers. The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals. The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members. Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned. Job Specifications Education and Experience Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment. Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience. Skills and Abilities Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables. Technical Expectations The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist. Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

title: Operations Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About PerkUp PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.Com. We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution. This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated. The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction. This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule. What you’ll own Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations. Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability. Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy. Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability. Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution. Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems;
gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix. Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls. Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement. What success looks like Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably. Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors. Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence. PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement. What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment. A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes. Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator. Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams. Excellent written and spoken English;
full professional fluency is required. Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams. Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output. A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure. Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth. Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking. Role details Location: Remote, Latin America Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time Engagement: Full-time contractor $4,500–$5,000 USD per month Growth path This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Writer (Brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads. Key Responsibilities 1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Head Of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Risk (Crypto) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies. Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security. Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale. Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time. Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them. Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly. Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams. Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change. Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards. Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS. Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions. Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams. Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles. Required Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent. 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations. 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture. Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services. Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.G., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution. Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM. Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design. Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal. Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend. Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment. Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs. Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS. How you work Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions. Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

Senior Business Analyst Role Overview The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers. The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members. Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts. Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes. Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements. Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation. Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members. Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options. Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management. Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes. Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions. Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution. Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities. Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency. Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs. Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders. Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment. Maintain regular and predictable attendance. Perform other duties as assigned. Job Specifications Education and Experience Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst. Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements. Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams. Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements. Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment. Preferred Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects. Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives. General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules. Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects. Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin. Insurance or financial services industry experience. Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience. Skills and Abilities Required Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills. Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes. Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation. Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work. Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment. Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods. Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables. Technical Expectations The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist. Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator.
